game.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
game.setting: Vice City and the state of Leonida, a modern-day take on Florida
game.rating: Mature: blood and gore, intense violence, mature humour, nudity, strong language, strong sexual content, drug and alcohol use; in-game purchases
game.source: Rockstar Games official GTA VI site

editions.name: Standard Edition
editions.summary: The base game. Pre-orders made before launch include the Vintage Vice City Pack.
editions.source: PlayStation Store listing as reported by Game Informer and others

editions.name: Ultimate Edition
editions.summary: The base game plus a collection of exclusive vehicles, weapons, shops and outfits woven through Jason and Lucia's story.
editions.source: Rockstar Games official media pack (Ultimate Edition Benefits)

editions.name: Vintage Vice City Pack
editions.summary: A retro bonus that harks back to Vice City's neon heyday: a '55 Vapid Stanier, exclusive 80s-style outfits and hairstyles, and a vintage weapon pattern.
editions.source: Rockstar Games official site and media pack (Vintage Vice City Pack)

editions.name: The Vice City Collection
editions.summary: A collector's box of physical merchandise sold through the Rockstar Store, separate from the game editions.

characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.summary: One half of the lead duo. Raised around con artists and criminals, Jason joined the Army to escape a rough adolescence, then drifted down to the Keys and back into what he knows: running errands for local drug smugglers.
facts: Works for drug runners in the Leonida Keys
Lives rent-free at one of Brian Heder's properties in exchange for help with shakedowns
lines: If anything happens, I'm right behind you.

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.summary: The other lead. Taught to fight by her father from childhood, Lucia ended up in the Leonida Penitentiary after standing up for her family, and walked out by sheer luck. Now she is done with half-measures and wants the better life her mother dreamed of back in Liberty City.
facts: Her family once lived in Liberty City
Sees a life with Jason as a possible way out
characters.quote: The only thing that matters is who you know and what you got.
lines: The only thing that matters is who you know and what you got.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.summary: A conspiracy-minded homebody and fellow associate of Brian's. Cal is happiest at home with a few beers, listening in on Coast Guard radio and falling down internet rabbit holes.
characters.quote: What if everything on the internet was true?
lines: What if everything on the internet was true?
There are way too many birds flying around in perfect formation.
The psychopaths are in charge. Get used to it.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.summary: A Vice City street legend who turned his past into a legitimate-looking empire: property, a strip club and a recording studio. Friendly right up until business comes up.
facts: Owns real estate, a strip club and a recording studio
Co-runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest
Linked to the Jack of Hearts club
characters.quote: It's all about heart — the Jack of Hearts.
lines: It's all about heart — the Jack of Hearts.
The club money pay for the studio, and the drug money pay for it all.

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.summary: More hustler than gangster, Dre'Quan always saw street dealing as a stepping stone to the music business. He now runs Only Raw Records with Boobie and has just signed the Real Dimez.
facts: Books acts into Boobie's strip club
lines: Dancers are like my A&Rs. If the record's a hit, DJs gonna be spinnin' it.

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.summary: High-school friends Bae-Luxe and Roxy went from shaking down local dealers to cashing in with explicit rap tracks and a constant social media presence. An early hit with rapper DWNPLY made them; five turbulent years later they have signed to Only Raw Records chasing a second one.
lines: All my dimes in this club. Meet my twin, make it a dub.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.summary: A charming, confident career bank robber always recruiting talent willing to take big risks for big rewards. His recklessness keeps raising the stakes for whoever works with him.
lines: Life is full of surprises, my friend. I think we'd all be wise to remember that.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.summary: A drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys, still moving product through his boatyard with his third wife, Lori. These days he lets others do the dirty work, including Jason, who lives at one of his properties.
facts: Runs a boatyard in the Keys
characters.quote: Nothing better than a Mudslide at sunset.
lines: Nothing better than a Mudslide at sunset.
I hauled so much grass in that plane, I could make the state of Leonida levitate.

characters.name: Lori
characters.summary: Brian Heder's third wife, who helps him run the boatyard and is known for her sangria.
facts: Named in Brian Heder's official profile

characters.name: DWNPLY
characters.summary: A Vice City rapper whose early collaboration with the Real Dimez gave the duo their first hit.
facts: Named in the Real Dimez official profile

cast.note: Rockstar has not officially announced any of GTA VI's voice or performance cast. Names circulating online are rumours and are not listed here until Rockstar or the performers confirm them.

places.name: Vice City
places.summary: The neon-lit metropolis at the heart of Leonida: beaches, high-rises, nightclubs and Art Deco strips, and the epicentre of Jason and Lucia's story.

places.name: Leonida Keys
places.summary: A chain of islands strung along the southern tip of the state: marinas, boatyards, turquoise water and a long smuggling history. It's where Jason's story begins.

places.name: Grassrivers
places.summary: Vast wetlands of sawgrass, mangroves and swamp, home to alligators, airboats and the people who prefer to stay off the grid.

places.name: Port Gellhorn
places.summary: A faded seaside town on the Gulf coast, with motels, piers and a beach-town nightlife that has seen better days.

places.name: Ambrosia
places.summary: An inland industrial and farming region of factories and open roads, with a biker presence shown in official screenshots.

places.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
places.summary: Leonida's wild north: forests, cliffs, rivers and trails for anyone heading into the backcountry.

vehicles.name: '95 Grotti Cheetah
vehicles.summary: A white 90s supercar with red pinstripes and pop-up headlights.

vehicles.name: '55 Vapid Stanier
vehicles.summary: A two-tone 1950s cruiser with tail fins and whitewall tyres.

vehicles.name: Squalo
vehicles.summary: A sleek white speedboat built for cruising the Vice City waterfront and the Keys.

vehicles.name: Vapid Buggy
vehicles.summary: A classic 60s muscle car turned into a lifted, mud-spattered off-road racer.

vehicles.name: Vapid Ganado Retro
vehicles.summary: A yellow coupe-utility with racing stripes, styled as a retro build.

vehicles.name: One-Eyed Willie
vehicles.summary: A lime-green Canis off-roader with chunky tyres and a light bar.

vehicles.name: Wyman Car Collection
vehicles.summary: A set of classic cars spanning muscle, off-road and racing styles, including a #36 race car and a stars-and-stripes coupe.

vehicles.name: Safehouse Vehicles
vehicles.brand: Various (dirt bike reported as Dinka Enduro)
vehicles.summary: An olive dirt bike, a kayak and a classic muscle car kept at a stilt-house safehouse on the water.
vehicles.aka: Dirt bike (reportedly a Dinka Enduro), kayak and muscle car

vehicles.name: Bravado Banshee
vehicles.summary: The long-running GTA roadster, identified by fans in trailer footage.

vehicles.name: Bravado Buffalo
vehicles.summary: A four-door muscle sedan, including police versions, seen across trailer footage.

vehicles.name: Bravado Gauntlet
vehicles.summary: A modern muscle coupe identified in trailer footage.

vehicles.name: Bravado Bison
vehicles.summary: A full-size pickup truck seen on Leonida's roads.

vehicles.name: Vapid Dominator
vehicles.summary: Vapid's muscle-car line, identified in several trailer shots.

vehicles.name: Vapid Sandking
vehicles.summary: A lifted monster-style pickup, at home in Grassrivers mud.

vehicles.name: Grotti Furia
vehicles.summary: A modern supercar identified in Vice City street scenes.

weapons.name: Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers
weapons.summary: A matched pair of engraved revolvers, one fitted with a scope.

weapons.name: Jason & Lucia's engraved sidearms
weapons.summary: Personalised pistols with decorative engravings and grips. Reported model names: Girardi ES9 (Jason) and Klose K17 (Lucia).

weapons.name: Vintage Vice City weapon pattern
weapons.summary: A retro Vice City finish for weapons, included with pre-orders.

weapons.name: Pump-action shotgun
weapons.summary: A classic pump shotgun shown in trailer action. The Extended Look's pickup prompt reportedly names a Moreland 850.

weapons.name: Carbine rifle
weapons.summary: M4-style carbines in a couple of variants. A Duke 556 rifle is reported from the Extended Look.

weapons.name: Submachine gun
weapons.summary: A compact automatic weapon seen in heist footage.

weapons.name: Sniper rifle
weapons.summary: Two long-range rifle types identified from trailer footage.

weapons.name: Grenade launcher
weapons.summary: Returns looking similar to GTA V's.

weapons.name: Flashbang
weapons.summary: Reportedly the flashbang's first appearance in a mainline GTA game.

weapons.name: Melee weapons
weapons.summary: Baseball bats, golf clubs and hammers have all appeared.

businesses.name: Only Raw Records
businesses.summary: Boobie Ike and Dre'Quan Priest's label, now home to the Real Dimez.

businesses.name: Jack of Hearts
businesses.summary: Boobie Ike's club, whose takings help fund the studio.

businesses.name: Electric Fang Tattoo
businesses.summary: A neon-lit tattoo bar. Reported to carry 50+ designs by the art collective FAILE.

businesses.name: Rideout Customs
businesses.summary: A custom shop specialising in lowriders, gold wheels and plush interiors.

businesses.name: Sara's Salon
businesses.summary: A salon for new hairstyles and looks (reported full name: Sara's Unisex Salon).

businesses.name: Stock 305
businesses.summary: A graffiti-covered clothing store. The name nods to Miami's 305 area code.

businesses.name: PTT store
businesses.summary: A store included with the Ultimate Edition. Full details to come.

businesses.name: Goodtime Gear
businesses.summary: Vice City souvenir-style tees and caps.

businesses.name: Brian's boatyard
businesses.summary: The yard Brian Heder still uses to move product.

score.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score
score.summary: An adaptive score by Grammy-winning French duo Justice (Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay) that shifts with how you play. Out on streaming, CD and vinyl.
singles: Flower in a Hurricane (ft. Tame Impala, SZA, King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard)

album.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album
album.summary: Thirty-four original tracks from a genre-hopping roster of artists, released alongside the game.
singles: That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) — Yung Lean
Sexy Magic — CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy
Last Thing You Need — Morgan Wallen
Bright Lights, Big City — Keith Richards

music.source: Rockstar Games official GTA VI music page

tracks.artist: Justice ft. Tame Impala, SZA, King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard

videos.summary: The final trailer before release, reaffirming the November 19 launch.

videos.title: Official Cover Art Reveal

news.title: Justice confirmed for the GTA VI original score
news.summary: Rockstar confirmed Justice are scoring GTA VI. The 30-track score album arrives December 11, with Flower in a Hurricane and Pusher out now.

news.title: GTA VI Launch Trailer released
news.summary: The launch trailer is out, ahead of the November 19 release on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

news.title: The Vice City Collection lands at the Rockstar Store
news.summary: A collector's box and GTA VI merchandise are now available from the Rockstar Store.

news.title: An Extended Look premieres
news.summary: Rockstar's extended gameplay look premiered on Netflix, then arrived on YouTube.

news.title: Price and Ultimate Edition revealed
news.summary: The Standard Edition was listed at $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition at $99.99 in the US, with the Vintage Vice City Pack for pre-orders. Physical copies reportedly come as a code in a box.

news.title: Official cover art revealed
news.summary: Rockstar revealed GTA VI's official cover art.

faq.a: Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, 2026.
PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar's site says it plays best on PlayStation 5.
Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version or date yet. Previous GTA games reached PC after their console launch.
In the US it's reported at $79.99 for the Standard Edition and $99.99 for the Ultimate Edition.

faq.q: Who are the main characters in GTA 6?
faq.a: Two protagonists: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.

In Vice City and the wider state of Leonida, inspired by modern-day Florida. Rockstar has named six regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

faq.q: What is the GTA 6 pre-order bonus?
faq.a: The Vintage Vice City Pack: a '55 Vapid Stanier, exclusive vintage outfits and hairstyles, and a weapon pattern.

faq.q: What's in the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition?
faq.a: Exclusive vehicles (including the '95 Grotti Cheetah and the Squalo speedboat), weapons such as the Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers, shops including Electric Fang Tattoo and Rideout Customs, and outfits.
Rockstar hasn't officially announced the cast. We'll add names once they're confirmed.
The original score is by Justice (out December 11), and Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album (34 tracks) releases November 19 with artists including Travis Scott, Cardi B, Morgan Wallen and Rauw Alejandro.
No. Leonida Files is an unofficial fan database by Hex Modifications, and isn't affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

timeline.title: Development confirmed
timeline.text: Rockstar confirms the next Grand Theft Auto is well underway.

timeline.title: Rockstar addresses the network intrusion
timeline.text: Rockstar confirms early development footage was taken in a network intrusion and says work continues as planned.

timeline.title: First trailer announced
timeline.text: Rockstar says the first trailer for the next GTA will arrive in December.

timeline.title: Trailer 1
timeline.text: Grand Theft Auto VI is officially revealed with Lucia, Vice City and a 2025 release window.

timeline.title: Trailer 2 and the official website
timeline.text: Jason and the supporting cast are introduced, with character and location profiles on the GTA VI site.

timeline.title: Cover art revealed
timeline.text: Rockstar reveals the official cover art.

timeline.title: Pre-orders and editions
timeline.text: Pre-orders open with the Ultimate Edition and the Vintage Vice City Pack. US prices are listed at $79.99 and $99.99.

timeline.title: An Extended Look
timeline.text: A long-form look at the game premieres on Netflix, then YouTube.

timeline.title: The Vice City Collection
timeline.text: A collector's box and merchandise launch on the Rockstar Store.

timeline.title: Score by Justice
timeline.text: Justice are confirmed as composers, with two singles out now.

timeline.title: Release day
timeline.text: GTA VI launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, alongside Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.

timeline.title: Original Score album
timeline.text: Justice's 30-track score is released on streaming, CD and vinyl.
